text:
maria: Heads up — Orbit just handed us EAP access. NDA attached. Wants next-steps on benchmarks & joint comms. Can we sync today?
aj: Nice. Who's owning NDA review? Legal or BD?
sanjay: I can take NDA review, but need the SKUs and whether they're sending MLPerf-style logs. Also need hardware serials for telemetry mapping.
ethan-biz: We should propose a 2-week alpha with perf probe + a follow-up joint blog. Orbit wants to be in marketplace launch. Marketing lead?
maria: Legal decks are cc'ed. I'll drop the NDA doc link: https://redwood.doc/ndas/orbit-eap-v1.pdf. Proposal: bench suite = latency p95, throughput, memory, cost-per-token. Use our standard hw-probe v2.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: EAP cluster namespace 'orbit-eap' created in us-west-2 :white_check_mark:
aj: For benchmarks can we reuse quant configs from the last silicon? Need to know if they support 4-bit kernels. Also add KV cache stress test.
sanjay: Orbit firmware note — older boards need kernel 1.8. I'll log that in the bench PR. Also need power profiles for sustained runs.
ethan-biz: Comms — don't promise dates. Suggest 'preview' blog + joint datasheet after alpha. Coordinate embargo and quote approvals. @marketing-sara please advise on timelines.
marketing-sara: On it. Timeline ask: we need final numbers 5 business days before embargo lift, plus approved quotes and logo clearance. Also prefer a short one-page datasheet draft before blog.
maria: Ok action items: 1) Sanjay — add hardware matrix + firmware notes by EOD. 2) Aj — confirm quant/kernels + KV stress by tomorrow noon. 3) Legal — review NDA by EOD. 4) Marketing Sara — draft comms cadence. We'll do async updates here. Ping if blocked.
sanjay: Started PR: https://git.internal/redwood/bench/orbit-eap. Adding initial telemetry tags and power logs.
legal-bot: legal-bot: NDA routed to contracts queue (ref ORB-2024-NDA).
sam-legal: Got it, ETA tomorrow morning. Quick Q: do we need additional export controls? Orbit's primary office is in the EU.
aj: We probably don't need a special license for bench logs, but check if they want HSM-wrapped telemetry or encrypted blobs.
maria: Great. Quick poll — preferred kickoff: Thu 10am PT or Fri 9am PT? vote with :+1: for Thu, :eyes: for Fri.
ethan-biz: :+1: Thu works for biz.
marketing-sara: :+1: Thu is good for content calendar.
sanjay: :eyes: I prefer Fri if possible — lab calibration conflict Thu morning.
aj: :+1: Thu ok for infra side.
maria: I'll go with Thu 10am PT and send invite. Meeting invite sent to Orbit, Sanjay, Aj, Ethan, Sara, Sam. If something changes, post here. Thanks!
